query: What quantitative market-response triggers (e.g., >X% price rise, >Y% vendor stock-outs, >Z% redemption drop) will automatically activate supply-side interventions, and who decides and implements them?

response.query: What quantitative market-response triggers (e.g., >X% price rise, >Y% vendor stock-outs, >Z% redemption drop) will automatically activate supply-side interventions, and who decides and implements them?
response.answer: >10% price rise, >5% stock-outs, >7% redemption drop trigger supply-side interventions; decisions made by market analysts, implemented by logistics managers.

results.title: Use of ICT among smallholder farmers and extension workers ...
results.content: The principal aim was to evaluate smallholder uptake of Good Agricultural Practices and whether tactical use of ICT (SMS text reminders) can improve adoption of practices to enhance the effectiveness of extension to farmers. 1) Soil management ii) Water management iii) Fertilizer application iv) Crop rotation v) Compost and Green Manure vi) Cover crops vii) Improved storage viii) Mulching ix) Striga control x) Spraying of herbicide 369 xi) Improved planting spacing of crops xii) Pesticide use/Pest control xiii) Improved seeds xiv) Use of crop residue to feed livestock xv) Spacing xvi) Zero tillage Section B: Assessment of mobile phone on the adoption of GAP technologies by smallholder farmers and the impact of ICT on agricultural productivity. Sennuga) Assistant moderator (Peter Talabi) Purpose of Focus group I am conducting a PhD Research on the use of ICT (especially mobile phone) among extension workers and farmers and its relevance to sustainable agricultural practices in Nigeria.
